question: A Supreme Court or High Court judge can be removed by the Parliament by ___________.

options.text: both simple and two third majority

solution:
The correct answer is __**special majority**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A judge of the Supreme Court or High Court can be removed from his office by an order of the President.
 
• The President can issue the removal order only to him in the same session for such removal.
 
• After an address by the Parliament has been presented address must be supported by a special majority of each House of Parliament</
